title: Flood, Libya, 12 August 2024 (FL20240812LBY)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, Libya, 12 August 2024 (FL20240812LBY), from 4 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: FL20240812LBY**  This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in Ghat City, Ghat Governorate, South Province, Libya as observed from a WorldView-3 satellite image acquired on 18 August 2024 at 11:53 local time (09:53 UTC). Within analysed area of about 65km², a total of about 13 km² of land appears to be affected by floodwaters. In Ghat City, approximately 5 km² (30%) of the city is flooded, which includes around 0.5 km² of built-up area. Additionally, about 13km of road is affected by the flooding
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
